name: Alitame
what_is: A high-intensity non-sugar sweetener identified by JECFA and Codex as INS 956.
why_botia: BOTIA flags an explicit alitame declaration because it may appear by name or INS number in markets where its use is permitted. International evaluation or a Codex provision does not mean the additive is authorised in every jurisdiction.
can_1: Detect alitame and INS 956 when explicitly declared.
can_2: Show the sweetener and international-numbering context while keeping market-specific authorisation separate.
cannot_1: Determine concentration or total intake from the ingredient list.
cannot_2: Assume that Codex/JECFA recognition equals legal authorisation in every country.
